limits: Contact/native selected-frame visual review proves observed trigger only, not exhaustive all-frame UI animation acceptance.
Official subset72 and authored extra76 represent74 button/air variants under two conditions, not all ordinary moves or all KOF98 states.
Early natural HP19/21 batches are DM despite low-life intent; critical-v5 repairs14 cases usingHP6–9; MAX only visually confirmed orange-flash cases.
Daimon chain-v1 wrong HCF second candidate preserved; chain-v2 author-corrected singleK105/DP165 still only first throw; full chain remains failed.
Athena QCB+P55 shoot candidate not distinguished from persistent orbit; cancel verified against uncancelled duration.
Kim close-air B DM and D critical timing failed; D DM/B critical combos observed.
Raw original screenshots/VRAM/palette remain locally complete and gitignored; final receipt hashes source/trace, not multi-GB raw payload.
